bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 132 (Tuesday, August 1, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. PORTER:
H.R. 5125.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 18 of the United States
Constitution
The single subject of this legislation is:
To amend the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act to limit the
use of arbitration to resolve controversies under the Act.
[Page H4159]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Economic Opportunity.

bill.title: End Servicemember Forced Arbitration Act
